trigger: The caller wants to cancel an appointment they already have, or move an existing appointment to a different time.

steps.instruction: Establish whether they want to cancel the appointment altogether or move it to another time. Ask only if it is not already clear. Romanian: Doriți să anulați programarea, sau să o mutăm pe altă zi? Hungarian: Le szeretné mondani az időpontot, vagy áthelyezzük egy más alkalomra?

Ask for the phone number the appointment was made with, and nothing else in this turn. Skip only if the caller already dictated a number earlier in this call. Romanian: Vă rog să-mi dictați numărul de telefon cu care s-a făcut programarea, cifră cu cifră. Hungarian: Kérem, diktálja be számjegyenként azt a telefonszámot, amellyel az időpontot foglalták. NEVER ask for the caller's name anywhere in this flow - not now, not later. The phone number alone finds the appointments, and the caller then confirms which one is theirs. Do not read the number back yet - that is the next step.

Apply the phone read-back gate exactly as your system prompt defines it, in the caller's language: read the number back once digit by digit in small groups, converting any compound numbers to single digits first, and END YOUR TURN with the question whether it is right - say nothing else in this turn: no holding line, no tool call. Romanian: Am notat unu, doi, trei — unu, doi, trei — unu, doi, trei. Este corect? Hungarian: Egy, kettő, három — egy, kettő, három — egy, kettő, három. Így helyes? This step is finished ONLY when the caller has answered. Until they answer, stay in this step and do nothing else. If they say it is wrong, read the corrected number back once more and wait again. Skip only if you already read this exact number back and the caller confirmed it earlier in this call.

YOU MUST CALL THE evolvo_find_appointments TOOL IN THIS STEP, and then get the caller to confirm ONE appointment out loud BEFORE anything is changed. Actually call the tool - never guess, invent or recall an appointment. Make the call ONLY after the caller has answered yes to the phone read-back, and send phone_confirmed true only then. Call with the phone exactly as the caller dictated and confirmed it (digits only, do not add or remove a leading zero). Send no name: the tool does not take one and you must not ask for one. If the result is confirm_phone_first: nothing happened yet - read the number back, ask if it is right, end your turn, and after the yes call again with phone_confirmed true. Do not cancel or change anything in this step. THEN, reading the result: these appointments belong to the caller's phone number, so you may say the person each one is for, its weekday, its date and its time out loud - never the doctor or any other detail. A record whose state is needs_reschedule is still a live appointment that still holds its slot: list it like any other, and if the caller now wants a new time go straight to the move flow without marking it again. If found is true and count is 1: name that one appointment and ask whether it is the one they mean, then wait for a clear yes. Romanian: Am găsit o programare pe numele Csergő Zsófia, miercuri, nouă septembrie, ora zece și douăzeci. Aceasta este programarea pe care doriți să o anulăm? Hungarian: Egy időpontot találtam Csergő Zsófia nevére, szerdán, szeptember kilencedikén, tíz óra húszkor. Ezt az időpontot szeretné lemondani? If found is true and count is more than 1: name them one at a time - the person, the weekday, the date and the time of each - and ask which one they mean, then wait. One phone number often covers a whole family, so the appointment may be for someone else in the household and that is normal. Romanian: Pe acest număr găsesc două programări: una pe numele Csergő Zsófia, miercuri, nouă septembrie, ora zece și douăzeci, și una pe numele Csergő Péter, joi, zece septembrie, ora nouă. Pe care dintre ele doriți să o anulăm? Hungarian: Erre a számra két időpontot találok: egyet Csergő Zsófia nevére, szerdán, szeptember kilencedikén, tíz óra húszkor, és egyet Csergő Péter nevére, csütörtökön, szeptember tizedikén, kilenc órakor. Melyiket szeretné lemondani? If the caller names a date or a person that matches none of them, say in ONE sentence that there is nothing on the date they named, name the weekday, date and time of the appointments that DO exist on this number, and ask whether they mean one of those - then wait for the answer. Never act on an appointment the caller did not explicitly confirm. If found is false: say in one sentence that there is no appointment on this number in the coming weeks, and ask whether it might have been booked with a different phone number - never ask for their name instead. IF THE TOOL ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, never retry more than once, and NEVER end the call because of it - say in one sentence that a colleague will call back to sort it out, and carry on with the call. This step is finished only when the caller has answered.

condition.condition: The caller explicitly confirmed one specific appointment from the list that was found for this phone number, and wants it cancelled altogether.

steps.instruction: YOU MUST CALL THE evolvo_manage_appointment TOOL IN THIS STEP. Actually call it - never tell a caller an appointment is cancelled without a successful call. Call once with action cancel, the same phone as the lookup, and the ref AND date copied from the ONE line of the appointments list the caller confirmed - never another line, never a ref you did not get from the tool. Send appointment_confirmed true, because the caller has just confirmed this exact appointment out loud. Put the reason in note if the caller gave one. If the result is confirm_appointment_first: NOTHING was cancelled - name the appointment in read_back to the caller in their own language (the person, the weekday, the date and the time), ask whether that is the one, end your turn, and after their yes call again with the same ref and appointment_confirmed true. If the result is ambiguous_appointment or ref_date_mismatch: nothing was cancelled - ask which of the appointments it listed they mean, and call again with that line's ref and date. THEN speak the outcome in the caller's language: if success is true, say in one short sentence that the appointment on that day has been cancelled. WHETHER THE TIME IS FREE AGAIN IS NOT YOURS TO ASSUME - the response tells you. Read slot_released and the note that comes with it. When slot_released is true, the time is bookable again: if the caller wants that same day and time back, or wants it for someone else, look it up with evolvo_check_availability and book it normally, and do not tell them the time is gone. When slot_released is false - whatever slot_release_status says, whether still_blocked, unknown, not_checkable_same_day or check_failed - NEVER tell the caller the time is free again and never offer to rebook it: say the appointment is cancelled, and if they want a new time offer to look for one. The note is already written for the caller in every case, so saying what it says is enough; never state that a slot is free from memory or from any rule you think you remember, only from slot_released being true. A cancelled appointment stays in Optofarm's own records marked as cancelled - that is normal and is not the caller's concern, so say it was cancelled and never that it was deleted or removed. If it returned not_found or appointment_not_found, say in one sentence that a colleague will call back to sort it out; never say it was cancelled. Never retry a failed call. IF THE TOOL ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, never say the appointment was cancelled, and NEVER end the call because of it - say in one sentence that a colleague will call back to sort it out and carry on. Finish this step by asking once whether there is anything else you can help with, and wait for the answer.

condition.condition: The caller explicitly confirmed one specific appointment from the list that was found for this phone number, and wants to move it to a different time.

steps.instruction: IN THIS STEP YOU MUST CALL THREE TOOLS IN ORDER, AND THE STEP IS NOT FINISHED UNTIL THE THIRD ONE HAS SUCCEEDED: first evolvo_manage_appointment, then evolvo_check_availability, then evolvo_book_appointment. THE ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: marking first and booking second is what releases the old slot. Booking before marking leaves the old slot blocked forever. An appointment marked for rescheduling with no new time booked is the worst possible outcome of this call - never let the procedure end that way, and never invent availability. FIRST call evolvo_manage_appointment once with action reschedule, the same phone as the lookup, the ref AND date copied from the ONE line of the appointments list the caller confirmed, appointment_confirmed true, and note set to roughly when the caller would prefer instead. If it answers confirm_appointment_first, ambiguous_appointment or ref_date_mismatch, nothing was changed: name the appointment back, get the caller's yes, and call again with the right ref and appointment_confirmed true. SECOND call evolvo_check_availability for the same doctor as the confirmed appointment (any branch unless the caller wants the same one), with date_from set to the period the caller asked for (for example a week later) or omitted if they gave none. THEN offer the new time and WAIT for the caller's answer - nothing is booked yet. From the availability result offer ONE day with one or two free times, saying the weekday, date, hour, doctor and branch in the caller's language, ONCE; if the caller named a date and requested_date_status is available, offer that day from requested_date_slots; if they want the soonest, offer the slot in earliest. Never read a list. Romanian: Am miercuri, douăzeci și trei septembrie, la ora nouă, la doamna doctor Baricz Anna, pe strada Gheorghe Doja. Vă convine? Hungarian: Szerdán, szeptember huszonharmadikán kilenckor van hely Baricz Anna doktornőnél a Dózsa György utcában. Megfelel? If the caller declines, offer at most one alternative from the result. Do not ask the caller which branch they prefer unless nothing is free with that doctor. THIRD, THE MOMENT the caller accepts a specific day and time, call evolvo_book_appointment - in that same turn, before you say anything else. Do NOT ask whether you can help with anything else, do NOT end this step and do NOT let the procedure finish until that call has returned success true. Send slot_accepted true and phone_confirmed true (the caller confirmed this number earlier in this call), full_name set to the person the confirmed appointment is for exactly as the lookup spelled it (the person field of that appointment - do NOT ask the caller for a name and do not retype it from what you heard), THE SAME confirmed phone as the lookup - a different number means the old appointment is NOT cancelled - the exact date and time of the accepted slot from the availability result, the doctor and location of that slot, and problem set to 'reschedule of the appointment on <old date>'. If the result is offer_slot_first: nothing was booked - offer the day and time, ask if it suits, end your turn, and after the yes call again with slot_accepted true. THEN speak the outcome in the caller's language, ONCE. If the booking succeeded (success true), the old appointment has ALREADY been dealt with for you and the response says so in replaced_appointment: when replaced_appointment.cancelled is true, say in one short sentence that the appointment has been MOVED to the new weekday, date and time, and NEVER call evolvo_manage_appointment again to cancel the old one - it is already gone, and trying would answer appointment_not_found and turn a finished move into an apology. When replaced_appointment.cancelled is false, say the new time is booked and that a colleague will tidy up the earlier one, and still do not try to cancel it yourself. THEN add the reminder sentence exactly as your system prompt gives it for this language, and follow that section for what the caller is told they will receive. THE REMINDER IS THE ONLY THING THE CALLER IS TOLD THEY WILL RECEIVE after a successful move. NEVER say a colleague will call them back about it - nobody rings the caller back about a booking that succeeded, and saying so makes a finished appointment sound unfinished. NEVER say a confirmation will be sent or will arrive, by any means: only a reminder is ever sent, and reminder is the only word for it. If booking_mode is lead_pending_staff_confirmation, say the new time is registered in exactly the same final way - it is just as booked to the caller, so still no callback and still only the reminder. If no new slot could be offered, the caller refused all of them, or the booking did not succeed, say in one sentence that the old appointment is marked for rescheduling and a colleague will call back to fix the new time - it still holds its original slot, so nothing has been lost; that is a booking that did NOT happen, which is the one place a callback is the right thing to promise. NEVER say the new time is booked or registered unless the tool returned success true, and never cancel the marked appointment as a tidy-up. Never retry a failed call more than once. IF ANY OF THE TOOLS ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, and NEVER end the call because of it - use the same sentence about a colleague calling back, and carry on. This step is finished ONLY when evolvo_book_appointment has returned success true, or the caller has refused every time you offered, or the availability lookup could offer nothing at all. Finish it by asking once whether there is anything else you can help with, and wait for the answer.

condition.condition: No appointment was found for this phone number, the lookup failed or could not be reached, or the caller said that none of the appointments found is theirs.

steps.instruction: Say in one sentence, in the caller's language, that a colleague will call back to sort it out. Do not guess which appointment was meant, and do not mention a system or a technical problem. If the caller instead says to leave everything as it is, skip the callback: say one short farewell and end the call.

Ask for the caller's full name and nothing else in this turn, and wait for the answer - here it is only written down for the colleague who will call back, so a mishearing is harmless. Skip if they already said their name in this call. Romanian: Vă rog să-mi spuneți numele dumneavoastră complet. Hungarian: Kérem, mondja meg a teljes nevét. Never continue with a placeholder such as necunoscut, ismeretlen or unknown.

YOU MUST CALL THE evolvo_log_request TOOL IN THIS STEP, but only if the caller still wants help with it. Actually call it - never claim a request has been passed on without a successful call. The phone number is already known and confirmed from this call - do not ask for it again and leave phone and phone_confirmed out of the call; the number already confirmed in this conversation is reused automatically. Call once with request_type callback, patient_name set to the real name the caller just gave (never a placeholder), language set to the language of this call, and summary as one or two plain sentences for a colleague in the language of the call: that the caller wants to cancel or move an appointment, the date they mentioned, and that no matching appointment could be found on this phone number. THEN speak the outcome in the caller's language: if success is true or duplicate is true, confirm in one sentence that the request has been passed on and a colleague will call them back. This is a callback request rather than a booking, so here a colleague calling back is exactly right and must be said. Never promise a specific callback time or person, and never invent a reference number. If success is not true, never say it was passed on. IF THE TOOL ERRORS, TIMES OUT, OR CANNOT BE REACHED: never mention a system, a tool, a technical problem or an error, never retry more than once, and NEVER end the call because of it - give them the branch's direct phone number and opening hours from your knowledge base instead, and carry on. Finish this step by asking once whether there is anything else you can help with, and wait for the answer.
